title: Community garden plot pass
naturalLanguageRequirements: A member of a community garden may pass a plot to another member. The source text does not say whether the garden association has to agree before the plot changes hands.
informalMarkdown:
# Functions

## Pass a plot

A member passes a plot to another member. Whether the garden association has to agree is not stated.

# Data Resources

## Plot

The plot records the bed number and the current member.

# Constraints

## One holder

A plot has one current member.

unresolvedSlots.question: Does a plot change hands only after the garden association agrees?

alternatives.label: A plot changes hands only after the garden association agrees in writing.
A plot changes hands when the two members record the pass, and the association does not have to agree.

unresolvedSlots.stakeholderAnswer: A plot changes hands only after the garden association agrees in writing.
